report:
Baseline: independently verified exact byte equality of current fns.rs and semantic_spec.rs against the historical implementation_sources and test_sources snapshots. The supplied historical report contains a claim-specific independent source rationale; I reassessed it against all current initial fragments and association metadata, rather than treating that approval as evidence of completion.

Fresh assessment: the complete claim requires symbol-keyed public checking boundaries, definition-derived scope/environment, signatures as the primary cross-item interface, permission for separate narrow field/member/language-required products, and exclusion of bodies and temporaries from those interfaces. The sole ordinary association is LocalFnSym::sig in fns.rs. Its receiver and database arguments supply no ambient caller environment; it constructs the resolver from self.scope, sets current_sym from self, opens the optional owner through signatures, combines owner/method generics and predicates, and returns a stashed Binder<FnSig>. open_owner is included in the same captured file, including no-owner, trait-owner, and impl-owner branches. Body checking is a separate tracked self-keyed query, consumes the signature and establishes its own inference context. These are concrete structural examples of the boundary; this review does not infer complete transitive dependency isolation from their call sites. No external helper implementation is relied on.

The complete associated test set is one explicit TODO: sage_meta::todo::checking_symbol_keyed_interfaces. Its empty body asserts nothing. Its comment requires a query-trace verification matrix demonstrating distinct signature/body roots, rejection of ambient caller parameters and callee-body reads, and reuse across interface-preserving edits. That trace harness/matrix is the prerequisite for behavioral verification, including separation of temporary/body state from cross-item dependencies. Narrow field/member products are permitted, not mandated by this claim; broader verification of any such products remains part of that boundary matrix, not established by the function example. The existing deferral honestly accounts for the unverified general guarantee and remains TODO; no implemented/test-complete verdict is asserted. No additional edits are requested.

Execution: ran review start, inspected all captured claim/implementation/test fragments and metadata, and performed exact baseline comparisons. No tests or build were run by this reviewer; the coordinator separately reports 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build passing. No source files were edited.
